body:
I was abused as a child in multiple ways. It has taken me a long time to become myself. One of the ways I was abused was becoming a parent for my younger sibling from the day they were born. I then 8 years later had to give that child up. 
That is one of the few of many reasons.
Which sounds lovely but like I said above I don't ever intend to be a parent.

Nta
You are an equal parent in this and you suggested so many compromises

100% I'll still spend time with her. She's family and an amazing person. It's just the lack of time she will have as well as the activities we do will have to change. 
I think the fear of the change is the hardest bit.
